source: Palo Alto Networks: the knowledge-base article on the base image for skip upgrades (KCSArticleDetail id kA14u0000008WwHCAU), the 'Determine the Upgrade Path' pages of the PAN-OS 10.2 and 11.1 upgrade guides, the Skip Software Version Upgrade feature (PAN-OS 11.0 release notes), and the LIVEcommunity thread 'Upgrade PAN OS from 10.1 to 11.1'; read 2026-11-02
min_content_feature_source: Palo Alto Networks release notes, 'Associated Content and Software Versions for PAN-OS x.y', 'Applications and Threats Content Release Version' row, read 2026-10-29 (12.1 from the release-notes PDF page 54; the others from the docs pages). One figure per release train, so it is the floor for the newest maintenance release; earlier maintenance releases can accept less (10.2.2 needs only 8552 although the 10.2 floor is 8614, hence the exact entry above wins). Not found: 9.1, 10.0, 12.0 and earlier (end-of-life or no page at the expected address).
min_content_source: Only entries seen on a real firewall so far. 10.2.2: PAN-OS itself refused the install on 2026-10-29 with 'Upgrading from 10.2.1 to 10.2.2 requires a content version of 8552 or greater and found 8545-7303'. Others: take from vendor release notes (minimum content release per PAN-OS release) and confirm. Keys are maintenance releases (hotfix numbers ignored); values are the app content number (the part before the dash).
